An 888-check finite decimal script corroborates but does not substitute for the analytic proof.

value.rationale: Determining the exact sharp \(m\)-concavity boundary for a natural first-order fractional-moment perturbation enables concrete application of higher-order lifting theory. The complete positive-defect rank staircase and its asymptotic density, combined with parameter-invariant negative Schatten tails, distinguish the finite-dimensional obstruction from persistent infinite-dimensional regularity. This is a motivated complete classification rather than merely computing a sample sign or deriving a routine corollary.
